title: The natural product salicin alleviates osteoarthritis progression by binding to IRE1alpha and inhibiting endoplasmic reticulum stress through the IRE1alpha-IkappaBalpha-p65 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhu, Zhenglin; Gao, Shengqiang; Chen, Cheng; Xu, Wei; Xiao, Pengcheng; Chen, Zhiyu; Du, Chengcheng; Chen, Bowen; Gao, Yan; Wang, Chunli; Liao, Junyi; Huang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨天然产物水杨苷结合IRE1alpha蛋白缓解骨关节炎，属于蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Despite the high prevalence of osteoarthritis (OA) in older populations, disease-modifying OA drugs (DMOADs) are still lacking. This study was performed to investigate the effects and mechanisms of the small molecular drug salicin (SA) on OA progression. Primary rat chondrocytes were stimulated with TNF-alpha and treated with or without SA. Inflammatory factors, cartilage matrix degeneration markers, and cell proliferation and apoptosis markers were detected at the mRNA and protein levels. Cell proliferation and apoptosis were evaluated by EdU assays or flow cytometric analysis. RNA sequencing, molecular docking and drug affinity-responsive target stability analyses were used to clarify the mechanisms. The rat OA model was used to evaluate the effect of intra-articular injection of SA on OA progression. We found that SA rescued TNF-alpha-induced degeneration of the cartilage matrix, inhibition of chondrocyte proliferation, and promotion of chondrocyte apoptosis. Mechanistically, SA directly binds to IRE1alpha and occupies the IRE1alpha phosphorylation site, preventing IRE1alpha phosphorylation and regulating IRE1alpha-mediated endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress by IRE1alpha-IkappaBalpha-p65 signaling. Finally, intra-articular injection of SA-loaded lactic-co-glycolic acid (PLGA) ameliorated OA progression by inhibiting IRE1alpha-mediated ER stress in the OA model. In conclusion, SA alleviates OA by directly binding to the ER stress regulator IRE1alpha and inhibits IRE1alpha-mediated ER stress via IRE1alpha-IkappaBalpha-p65 signaling. Topical use of the small molecular drug SA shows potential to modify OA progression.
abstract_zh: 尽管骨关节炎（OA）在老年人群中患病率很高，但改善病情的骨关节炎药物（DMOADs）仍然缺乏。本研究旨在探讨小分子药物水杨苷（SA）对OA进展的影响及其机制。用TNF-α刺激原代大鼠软骨细胞，并给予或不给予SA处理。在mRNA和蛋白水平检测炎症因子、软骨基质退化标志物以及细胞增殖和凋亡标志物。通过EdU实验或流式细胞术分析评估细胞增殖和凋亡。利用RNA测序、分子对接和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性分析来阐明机制。采用大鼠OA模型评估关节内注射SA对OA进展的影响。我们发现SA挽救了TNF-α诱导的软骨基质退化、软骨细胞增殖抑制及凋亡促进。机制上，SA直接结合IRE1α并占据IRE1α磷酸化位点，阻止IRE1α磷酸化，并通过IRE1α-IκBα-p65信号调节IRE1α介导的内质网（ER）应激。最后，在OA模型中，关节内注射载有SA的乳酸-乙醇酸共聚物（PLGA）通过抑制IRE1α介导的ER应激改善了OA进展。总之，SA通过直接结合ER应激调节因子IRE1α，并通过IRE1α-IκBα-p65信号抑制IRE1α介导的ER应激，从而缓解OA。小分子药物SA的局部应用显示出改善OA进展的潜力。
